review_description: Luke was very knowledgeable, listened to my requirements, gave several options, and he stepped me through all the stages. The installation was professional, safety conscious (two storey and a 35 degree pitch roof) and they cleaned up after themselves. They helped set up the grid connection and advised me on all the things I needed to do to complete the process.  Highly recommend this company.
The result is better than I expected and with the great Enphase monitoring system I can constantly see how the system is performing.
very happy with the service ,looking forward to my bill. Love the solar command system
